verses.text: Ix yalanxi winhaj Eliú chi' icha tik:
Ha tikne'ik ak' niwank'olal, yujto ol ach in k'ayb'ej, ayto tas ol wal yuj swach'ilok Dios.
Ol wak'lab'ej jantak in jelanil yik tzin ch'oxaneli to ha Dios chi' b'ojinak onh, tojol ton paxi.
Ojtakejeli to a tas swal tik t'ayach manh esok. Ha in tzin lolon et' tik, tz'akan in jelanil.
Ha Dios te ay spoder, te ay pax sjelanil, palta malaj junok mach spatikejeli.
Ha heb' chuk sk'ulej, scham heb' yuj Dios chi', haxo heb' tz'ixtaji, sb'oji yaj heb' yuj.
Ha stanhwan heb' anima wach' sb'eyb'al. Ha tz'ak'anoch heb' yajalil yik sb'inaj heb' t'a masanil tiempo.
Haxo heb' sk'ulan chukal, tato stzek'chaj heb' t'a k'e'en cadena, syab' wal sya'il heb'.
Ha Dios sch'oxani b'ajtak tz'och smul heb' chi' yujto tzek' heb' t'a yib'anh.
Sloloni yik skachan heb', syalani to syaktejkan schukal heb' chi'.
Tato scha yab' heb', syak'anoch sb'a heb' t'a yol sk'ab', tzalajk'olal tzek' heb', hato syal jantak sk'inal heb' syak'a'.
Palta tato max scha yab' heb' jun, xikjicham heb', sb'atkan heb' t'a skal heb' chamnak yujto maj yak'och heb' t'a sk'o'ol tas syal Dios.
Ha heb' malaj yelk'och Dios t'ay, aynhejkot yowal heb'. Wach'chom tz'ak'jioch syahelal heb' yuj, palta max yal-laj sb'a heb' t'ay yik sk'anan skolwal heb' t'a yib'anh.
Spet cham heb', k'ixwelal tz'aj satel heb'.
Ha t'a skal syahelal junok mach, ha Dios tz'ak'an nachajel smul, yik skolchaj t'a skal syahelal chi'.

Mamin Job, icha chi' snib'ej Dios tzach yutej. Tzach yik'anelta t'a skal a yahelal, tzach yik'anb'at t'a jun lugar te wach' b'aj manhxa tas syak' palta t'ayach, yik tzak' tzalajb'ok a k'o'ol t'a wa'el jantak swach'il.
Palta haxo tikne'ik, ha Dios tzach ch'olb'itani, a yahelal smoj scha'an heb' chuk, a chi' wan a cha'ani.
Yuj chi' ya'ilej a b'a yik wach' manh elanhchamelok tzach satel yuj yowal sk'ol Dios. Manh ol yal a kolchaj t'a yowal sk'ol chi' yuj jantakok tumin.
Malaj yelk'och a b'eyumal t'a sat. Malaj pax yelk'och jantak ipalil t'ay.
Mokab' a nib'ejkot sk'ik'alk'inalil chamel t'a ib'anh, haton stiempo'al satjiel niwak chonhab' t'a elanhchamel.
Ya'ilej a b'a yik max a nib'ejb'at a b'a t'a chukal, yujto a yahelal tik ix jawi t'a ib'anh yik max ach b'at t'a chukal chi'.
Scham wal ilan jantak spoder Dios. Malaj junok k'ayb'um syal slajb'an sb'a yet'ok.
Malaj junok mach syal yalan tas sk'ulej, malaj mach syal yalanoch t'a sat to chuk ix sk'ulej.
Masanil anima tz'alan wach' lolonel yuj tas wach' ix sb'o Dios chi'. Ya'ilej pax a b'a yik max b'at satk'olal halan wach' lolonel t'ay.
Masanil anima tz'ilan tastak b'ob'il yuj, wach'chom najatnhej syilb'at heb'.
Maxtzak nachajel ku'uj jantak sniwanil yelk'ochi, max yal ko b'isan jantak yab'ilal.
Ha tz'ik'ank'e jantak ha ha' t'a cha'anh, smeltzajoch ha' nhab'il.
Smolan sb'a ha' t'a skal asun, slajwi chi' yax nhab' tz'aj yem ha' t'a kib'anh.
Malaj mach snachajel yuj tas tz'aj spukaxb'at asun chi' yuj, ma tas yuj sk'anh k'u t'a satcha'anh b'aj ay skajnub'.
Ha tz'ak'anek' kopoljok lheb'lon t'a spatiktak b'aj ayek'i, palta a yich ha' mar, hanheja' k'ik'k 'inal yilji.
Icha tik tz'aj sch'olb'itan juntzanh chonhab', syak'an jantak wa'el t'a heb' anima.
Ha yamjinak lheb'lon, syumanb'at b'aj syal sk'o'ol, t'inhannhej sk'och b'aj sk'och chi'.
Ayik sk'anh k'u chi' a sch'oxani to wan skot niwak ik'nhab', inatax nok' molb'etzal nok', yojtak nok' to wanxo skot ik'nhab' chi'.
